title: Crypto Trading Signals - August 14, 2026
top_story_headline: Polymarket acquires Turf, adding its six-person team behind a real-time NFL prediction game to help build its US web and app experience
top_story_comment: Turf had already put next-play, next-drive and next-score predictions beside NFL broadcasts before announcing its Polymarket partnership on April 16. The six-person team gives Polymarket a consumer UX layer to plug into its Splash Sports deal, which reaches more than 2 million active pool players for the 2026 NFL season.
